description: Source code for a parser that processes Less documentation comments and sections, used in Bootstrap's Grunt build process.

classes.name: Section
classes.description: Represents a section in the Less documentation with heading, id, and subsections.

classes.name: SubSection
classes.description: Represents a subsection within a section, containing variables.

classes.name: VarDocstring
classes.description: Encapsulates a markdown-formatted variable documentation string.

classes.name: SectionDocstring
classes.description: Encapsulates a markdown-formatted section documentation string.

classes.name: Variable
classes.description: Represents a Less variable with name, default value, and optional documentation.

classes.name: Tokenizer
classes.description: Tokenizes the file content into sections, subsections, variables, and documentation strings.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: Main parser class that processes the tokenized content into structured sections and variables.

methods.name: markdown2html
methods.description: Converts markdown string to HTML using the markdown module.

methods.name: Section.prototype.addSubSection
methods.description: Adds a subsection to a section.

methods.name: SubSection.prototype.addVar
methods.description: Adds a variable to a subsection.

methods.name: Tokenizer.prototype.unshift
methods.description: Pushes a token back onto the tokenizer buffer.

methods.name: Tokenizer.prototype._shift
methods.description: Retrieves the next token from the input lines, parsing lines into section, subsection, variable, or docstring objects.

methods.name: Tokenizer.prototype.shift
methods.description: Retrieves the next token, skipping undefined tokens.

methods.name: Parser.prototype.parseFile
methods.description: Parses the entire file content into an array of sections.

methods.name: Parser.prototype.parseSection
methods.description: Parses a single section, including its docstring and subsections.

methods.name: Parser.prototype.parseSubSections
methods.description: Parses all subsections within a section.

methods.name: Parser.prototype.parseVar
methods.description: Parses a single variable, including its documentation string.
